digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing infrastructure (canary filers, reconciler applier)
propositions: Automated bug filers (heartbeat alert, binding-drift alert, conflict filer) lack dedup logic and file duplicate tickets, particularly on single flakes or when configuration changes break create gates.

Heartbeat-alert filer must implement N>=2 consecutive-red threshold via workflow run-history query (previous run conclusion signal) with no new state store, while binding-drift filer requires no threshold (drift is persistent state) and conflict filer requires per-conflict stable dedup tag.

All three filers must implement accumulation-comment dedup (max one per 24h via marker-line search in ticket history), abort-if-empty detail validation, and detected_by environment stamping per the bug-creation contract.
Conflict filer in applier.py lacks templated body, stable dedup tag, empty-detail abort, and detected_by stamping; heartbeat and binding-drift filers lack template contract and abort-if-empty guards.
Bug-creation contract (exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, detected_by env var) must be documented for all current and future auto-filers to ensure well-formed creation.

Green-run recovery path for heartbeat/binding-drift (existing auto-close via rebar transition open closed) differs from conflict filer (no auto-close; needs adjudication); audit table must enumerate all sites, pattern elements, and rationale.
